messages.subject: Package tutorial Monday
parts:
Hi all,

This coming Monday I'll be giving a tutorial on making R packages at D-RUG.

I'm going to try to make this a "follow along" style tutorial.  The workflow I describe requires that you have a few things installed, so if you want to follow along, please make sure you have these installed on your computer:

 - RStudio (http://www.rstudio.com/ide/): I'll be using RStudio's package-making tools
 - Git (http://git-scm.com/downloads): Git is version control software.  I will not be giving a tutorial on git, but using just a few features in conjunction with RStudio in order to facilitate sharing code.
 - Some R packages that help with package creation.  Just run:

   install.packages(c("devtools", "roxygen2", "testthat"))

Finally, I suggest that you create an account on github.com.  I'll be showing how to use github to share your packages so that others can install them, even if they're not ready for prime time on CRAN.

See you Monday.  Same time, same place: 3-5 in Wickson 2120J.  I expect the tutorial to take most of the 2 hrs.

Best

Noam
